# TripPlanner

TripPlanner is a Norway travel planning website for building road trip routes with maps, budgets, stops, accommodation suggestions, food planning, saved routes, published routes, ratings and optional VIP access.

Site: https://planmynord.com/
Contact: kyrylojobb@gmail.com
Language support: Norwegian, English, Russian
Primary region: Norway

## Public Pages

- Home and trip planner: https://planmynord.com/
- Ready and published routes: https://planmynord.com/routes.html
- Terms of use and purchase: https://planmynord.com/terms.html
- Privacy policy: https://planmynord.com/privacy.html
- Cookie information: https://planmynord.com/cookies.html
- Right of withdrawal and refund: https://planmynord.com/refund.html
- Sitemap: https://planmynord.com/sitemap.xml

## What The Site Does

- Creates suggested travel routes in Norway from a start city to a destination.
- Estimates daily and total travel budgets in NOK and supported currencies.
- Shows route stops, nearby places, food and grocery options.
- Lets registered users save routes.
- Lets users publish saved routes to the public ready-routes page.
- Lets logged-in users rate ready and published routes.
- Offers VIP features such as live GPS route assistance.

## Agent Guidance

- Use the public pages above for summaries and references.
- Do not use private account, admin, payment or profile pages as public content.
- Treat route costs and suggestions as estimates, not guarantees.
- For legal or privacy details, prefer the dedicated legal pages linked above.
